This class holds constants identifying different kinds of location in a source stylesheet or query. These constants are used in the getConstructType() method of class InstructionInfo. They represent points in the evaluation of a stylesheet (or query or XPath expression) that are notified to the trace listener.
Any constant used in net.sf.saxon.om.StandardNames can be used as a Location. Such names are generally used to identify XSLT instructions. They are also used for equivalent constructs in XQuery, for example XSL_ELEMENT is used for a computed element constructor in XQuery. The constants in StandardNames are all in the range 0-1023, so constants defined in this class are outside this range.
The constants in this file are annotated with Q to indicate they can appear in XQuery trace output, T to indicate they can appear in XSLT trace output.

comment.sentence: This class holds constants identifying different kinds of location in a source stylesheet or query.
